title: 25 Vulnerabilities in the x402 Protocol: Inside Three Critical Findings
notes: Industry security review of the x402 codebase, read 2026-11-15T02:54Z UTC. Reports 25 findings: 3 critical and 13 high sent to the x402 team on 2026-08-12, and 9 medium and low on 2026-09-09; says the 3 critical ones were fixed by 2026-08-20. Describes only the three critical findings (a Solana approval accepted as a transfer, cross-site SIWX login signatures, no default spending limit) and publishes no proof of concept.

title: [Bug]: Paywall bypass in parameterised routes (v1.2.0) (x402 issue #3850)
notes: Opened 2026-10-19T14:29:06Z; open on 2026-11-14. The legacy V1 middleware (findMatchingRoute in typescript/packages/legacy/x402/src/shared/middleware.ts) decodes the path with decodeURIComponent before matching, so /api/4%2f2/premium-content no longer matches the paid pattern /api/:id/premium-content while Express and Hono still route it to the handler. On origin/main 1a08434 the code still decodes before it matches. No GHSA or CVE (gh api, 2026-11-15T03:03Z).

title: The Brave Search API now accepts agentic payments via the x402 protocol
notes: Marked Published Nov 12, 2026 (RSS pubDate Thu, 12 Nov 2026). Brave runs its own facilitator that accepts USDC on Base; other networks and stablecoins are announced as coming. LLM Context, web, news, image, video and local endpoints cost $0.005 per request ($5 per 1,000); Base gas is covered for a limited time; no Brave Search API account or API key is needed. Recommends Stripe's purl CLI wallet.

title: Brave Search API documentation: Agent payments
notes: Read 2026-11-15T04:40Z UTC (markdown twin). The proxy at https://search.agent.s.brave.app serves the Search API without an API key or account; each request carries its own stablecoin payment. Answers, Autosuggest and Spellcheck are not sold there and still need an API key.

title: Brave Search API agent payments proxy: llms.txt
notes: Read 2026-11-15T04:40Z UTC. Says this deployment takes the x402 rail only and that x402 there is V2 only (a V1 X-Payment header is not recognized); headers Payment-Required, Payment-Signature and Payment-Response; x402 verifies first, then runs the search, then settles, and a failed search is never charged. Eight paid paths (/res/v1/web/search, /llm/context, /news/search, /videos/search, /images/search, /local/place_search, /local/pois, /local/descriptions); clients purl, @x402/fetch and mppx. It also says the service supports both rails, a deployment may run only one, and its rail table lists only x402; the second rail is not named.

title: Unpaid request to the Brave Search API x402 proxy (402 challenge, measurement)

No WWW-Authenticate header. /openapi.json lists the eight paid operations with an x-payment-info block.

title: CDP x402: Agentic accounts overview
notes: Read 2026-11-15T03:00Z UTC (markdown twin). Lists two options for an x402 buyer: Wallet MCP, a wallet an agent uses to discover and pay x402 services, and Coinbase for Agents, which connects an agent to a Coinbase account through a remote MCP server or a local CLI. The Wallet MCP page (https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/ai-agents/coinbase-for-agents/wallet-mcp) supports USDC payments on Base with the exact, upto and auth-capture schemes, accepts x402 payments on Base or Base Sepolia, and needs the user's approval and a wallet signature for each paid request. The former Agentic Wallet pages under /x402/agentic-accounts/agentic-wallet answered 404 on 2026-11-14.

publisher: Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (Federal Register)
notes: 91 FR 67000 to 67194, Docket OCC-2025-0372, RIN 1557-AF41, action Final rule; effective 2027-01-18 (Federal Register API and full text, read 2026-11-15T03:23Z UTC). title: Position of the Council at first reading: Payment Services Regulation (ST 8543/1/26 REV 1, 2023/0210(COD))
notes: Dated Brussels, 2026-11-04, headed adopted by the Council on 2026-10-29; 389 pages. Recital 29 excludes e-money token exchange and trading by crypto-asset service providers from the Regulation but not transfer services in which e-money tokens pay for goods or services; recital 30 excludes transfers between two self-hosted addresses with no intermediary on either side. No provision on AI agents (searched for artificial intelligence, agentic, AI agent and autonomous); the text does not mention facilitators or relayers.

title: Position of the Council at first reading: Payment Services Directive (PSD3) (ST 8535/1/26 REV 1, 2023/0209(COD))
notes: Dated Brussels, 2026-11-04, headed adopted by the Council on 2026-10-29; 184 pages. Article 47 inserts a new paragraph 4a in MiCA Article 60: a payment institution may provide crypto-asset services in relation to e-money tokens for the purposes of its payment services if it notifies its home supervisor at least 40 working days before. The Legislative Observatory shows both files awaiting Parliament's second reading, with an indicative plenary date of 2026-12-14 (read 2026-11-15T03:26Z UTC).

title: Circle Facilitator Service (hosted x402 facilitator)
notes: Read 2026-11-15T04:45Z UTC (markdown twin). Circle's hosted x402 facilitator for sellers settles USDC on Arc, Base and Polygon PoS with the EIP-3009 exact scheme and supports upto on Arc, Base and Polygon PoS mainnet and Arc testnet. Circle verifies each buyer-signed authorization, broadcasts every transfer, pays settlement gas and screens both parties; a Circle API key is needed to settle, with a keyless trial to start. The disclaimer says it does not hold, control or transmit user funds, and that Base and Polygon PoS settlements carry reorganization risk while Arc settlements are final. No price is published on the page.

title: docs(specs): add facilitator-managed voucher mode to EVM batch-settlement (v1.1) (x402 PR #3725)
notes: Merged 2026-10-26T17:13:54Z (commit be54b7d). On origin/main 1a08434, specs/schemes/batch-settlement/scheme_batch_settlement_evm.md defines two voucher-management modes: self-managed, the default, where the resource server keeps the latest voucher, and facilitator-managed (extra.voucherManager facilitator), where the facilitator verifies every payload, persists vouchers, chargedCumulativeAmount and chargeCount, and runs the claim and settle schedule. Go implemented it in PR #3726 (merged 2026-10-27, released in Go v2.29.0 on 2026-10-28) and TypeScript in PR #4061 (merged 2026-11-04, released in @x402/evm 2.30.0 on 2026-11-04).
